title: IT Administrator - (Senior) IT Administrator
description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

    • IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

    • IT Security & Compliance 

    You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

    You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

    • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


    • What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  


    • For the Senior IT Administrator level

    Candidates considered for the Senior IT Administrator level should additionally bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant hands-on IT administration or systems engineering experience, ideally in a technical or engineering-driven environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across Linux and macOS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex endpoint and system issues.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of MDM, IAM, SSO/MFA, endpoint security, networking, and access management.
  • Strong networking knowledge with practical experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
  • Experience independently owning technical projects from solution design and implementation through documentation and ongoing operation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, networks, cloud services, identity, and infrastructure, with the ability to resolve complex issues without relying primarily on external providers.
  • Experience using scripting and automation to improve IT operations and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Ability to proactively identify weaknesses in an existing IT environment and independently propose and implement secure, scalable improvements.
  • Experience acting as a technical escalation point and supporting or mentoring less experienced colleagues.
  • Ability to work confidently with Engineering and DevOps teams and communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • A strong security mindset and interest in taking increasing ownership of Information Security, ISO 27001, TISAX, and ISMS-related topics.

    • Previous hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, TISAX, an ISMS, or security audits is an advantage for the Senior level, but not required.

    Most importantly, you: 

  • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

  • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

  • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

  • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

  • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

  • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  

    •  


    Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


    • Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

    • About Apex.AI

    Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

title: Software Engineer, Data
Operations & Strategy Manager - Energy Markets
description:
Operations & Strategy Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our mission for you

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers.

 

About trawa

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

The Team

You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates.

 

Who we are looking for

  • Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

  • Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus.

  • Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work.

  • Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus.

  • High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus.

  • Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

What you'll do

As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive:

  • Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. You make this process faster, more robust and scalable.

  • Stabilise and grow our margins: Our customers hedge their energy costs with long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Futures/Forwards. You are responsible for stabilising our margins on these hedges and increasing them in the medium term – covering a multi-million euro gross margin.

  • Pave the way to more complex products: Over the past three years, we have shown that we can profitably price, buy and sell energy. You build on that foundation and develop our long-term offering towards more complex, higher-margin products that fit our customers' needs even better.

  • Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets – so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

 

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • Business understanding: You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

  • Portfolio knowledge: You understand our long-term product portfolio (PPAs, Futures/Forwards), our customers' hedging needs and how pricing, margins and risk come together in our offers.

  • CPQ mapping: You have mapped our current CPQ process – from customer request and pricing to offer creation and trade execution – and identified the key pain points and margin levers.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Go-to CPQ owner: You are the go-to person for our CPQ process and have implemented first improvements that make it faster and more robust.

  • Margin transparency: You have created transparency on our margins across long-term hedges and derived first measures to stabilise them.

  • Target process: You have designed a target CPQ process, started its implementation and proposed first, more complex products for our long-term offering.

 

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

We are scaling fast and investing heavily in our product, our clients and our international footprint. We are looking for a Strategy Intern to join our Strategy team and help us shape what comes next.

About the role:

As Strategy Intern, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez, and our wider leadership team, including our CEO and Founder, Martin Kassing. You will support Upvest's most important strategic work, from high-stakes leadership and board meetings to initiatives such as market expansion and new products. You will own your own work packages, working independently and cross-functionally, with direct exposure to senior leadership. This is a high-impact, highly visible role and a great way to learn how a fast-growing fintech is run, with a deep look into our product, clients, operations and the banking ecosystem.

What you’ll do:

  • Support high-stakes internal projects: Help the team prepare and run all-hands, leadership offsites and presentations, and board meetings

  • Support strategic initiatives: Contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives, such as market expansion or new products, from research and analysis to preparing recommendations and materials to the actual execution and project management

  • Support the OKR process: Help run the company OKRs, link them to core business KPIs and support cross-team prioritisation

  • Own your work packages: Take ownership of your own work packages, working independently and cross-functionally to deliver them

  • Become an AI champion: Learn and adapt to new AI tools, and help upskill the organisation by sharing what works

What you bring:

  • Experience: You have already completed 1-2 internships in highly dynamic environments, ideally in consulting or at other fintechs or high-growth scale-ups

  • Business acumen: You have high business acumen and quickly understand how a business works and what drives it. You break down complex problems into actionable insights and measurable outcomes, and care about the details to ensure flawless execution

  • Curiosity and drive: You are curious, highly motivated and eager to learn across the board. You are proactive and happy to support on different projects. You are passionate about fintech and the mission of empowering more people to invest

  • AI-native: You use AI tools proactively in your day-to-day work (synthesis, research, reporting) and are always looking for smarter, faster ways of working

  • Communication and stakeholder management: You communicate clearly and confidently and enjoy working with colleagues at all levels, including senior leadership

  • Team player: You are open, collaborative and a cultural ambassador who lives our values

  • Location and availability: You are based in Berlin and available for a minimum of 4 months

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We're working on solving a hard problem: fixing the European investment infrastructure so that more people are able to invest. You have the opportunity to contribute to this change.

  • Learning and development: We invest in your growth, offering access to personal coaching and mental health support through our Nilo platform, alongside plenty of opportunities to develop in your role. Working in the complex yet fascinating world of investments, with an API product built on a state-of-the-art tech stack and alongside leading fintechs and financial institutions, offers an incredibly rewarding learning experience.

  • An exceptional team: Upvengers are one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a relaxed and fun atmosphere. We have strong practices around feedback, team health and social events, resulting in a constantly high eNPS.

  • Culture: We live a culture of empowerment, trust (that we hire the best people and get out of their way) and openness (there's a greater advantage in sharing information than keeping it to ourselves).

  • Flexibility: While we're not quite fully remote, we are committed to being a flexible employer, as we understand you don't have to be in the office to do your best work. This role is based in Berlin.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)
description:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

description:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. title: Forward Deployed Intern
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster.

As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core.

What you will do

Learn the business

Build , Measure & Share

  • Build automations, small agents, scripts and dashboards with AI tools such as Claude.

  • Ship first versions quickly and improve them with feedback from the people who use them.

  • Track whether what you built saves time or prevents mistakes.

  • Decide with your mentor what to improve and what to stop.

  • Document what you built so others can use it.

  • Show your work in demos to the team.

What success looks like

  • Several tools or automations in daily use by our teams

  • Measured time savings for at least one team

  • Clear documentation others can build on

  • A solid understanding of how a global trade works end to end

What you bring

  • You are enrolled in a degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a similar field.

  • You can code, for example in Python or JavaScript, and use AI tools in your daily work.

  • Real curiosity about how businesses work, not only about technology.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems.

  • Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements.

  • Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator.

  • Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha.

  • Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator.

  • High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes.

  • Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential).

  • Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings.

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-45 min)

title: Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have a direct influence on our success.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you lead the efforts of maintaining and improving our global identity and access management platform as a coherent set of highly available services following our cloud-focused strategy. It is your responsibility to identify improvement opportunities, drive identity projects, and build a unified, scalable environment.

Based in Germany and the US, our IT Infrastructure Services team designs, implements, and manages global cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions to provide Flix with internal business services such as identity and access management, security and compliance configuration, communication tools, file sharing, 3rd-level support, and infrastructure consulting.

About the Role

  • Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO) following best practices
  • Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts
  • Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management
  • Drive innovation and improve our services together with the team
  • Automate recurring tasks
  • Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

  • At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms
  • Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SAML)
  • At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)
  • At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations
  • Basic experience using APIs
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus
  • Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

In this role, you will:

  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with:

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets - Working towards daily, weekly and monthly targets and finalize all sales in a timely manner.

  • Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.

  • CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.

  • Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.

  • Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

  • Professional proficiency in English

Being a Clinical Recruiter at AIOS

You’ll own clinical hiring across Bolt Pharmacy in the UK and our new pharmacy in the Netherlands. That means our UK Superintendent Pharmacist, 2 clinical team leads, at least 11 UK clinical hires, and the full Netherlands clinical team in Q1.

You run every search end to end: sourcing, screening, registration checks, and closing. You also run our clinical recruiting agencies and hold them to our bar. Sloppy screening puts patients and our pharmacies at risk, so your standards are relentless.

Our cultural standards

description:

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

 

Being a Clinical Ops Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Clinical Ops Lead at AIOS Tech, you’ll build an A+ clinical operations team at scale. You’ll also be our CQC Registered Manager, personally accountable for the safety and quality of our regulated service.

You’ll:

  • Lead a fast-growing UK clinical ops team. Set the bar high and make sure your team holds it.

  • Be our CQC Registered Manager. We’re inspection-ready every day, and you build the systems that keep us there.

  • Nail capacity planning. No backlogs, no long waits, no clunky patient experiences.

  • Build an operation that runs itself. Clear KPIs and SLAs, and performance management that’s automated first, so it scales as we grow.

You’re a killer operator first. You run on numbers, cadence and relentless follow-through. You spot problems before they show up in the data, fix them at the root and make sure they don’t come back. To you, the best-run operation is also the safest and most compliant one.

Our patients deserve a world-class experience. You use technology to close gaps, keep standards high and redesign pathways around what’s best for patients.

You’re not pretentious. You’ll get stuck in with the leads who report to you and make sure our strategy holds up as we scale. You’ll work with our Talent team to hire and keep the sharpest people in the country.

Doing this well means we become the UK’s largest GLP-1 provider and expand into new verticals, safely, compliantly and without slowing down.

This is a full-time, fully remote role in the UK, with occasional travel to Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is a Lead role. You’ll report directly to our Head of Clinical Product & NI, Farah Haque. We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll also work closely with:

  • Arvee Sese-Bondoc, Customer Support Lead

  • Phuong Nguyen, Superintendent Pharmacist

  • Rich Hannibal, Head of Customer Experience & Operations

  • Zoe Wheeler, UK People Lead

 

Key responsibilities

  • Registered Manager: You’re our CQC Registered Manager and personally accountable for safe, high-quality care. You own our relationship with the CQC, set our compliance strategy and make sure the business meets the fundamental standards as it scales.

  • Quality: Working with the NI, you set our path to an Outstanding rating. You build a service that runs to the CQC’s five key questions by default, so we’re inspection-ready every day.

  • Governance: You design and lead our governance framework for incidents, complaints, safeguarding and duty of candour. You make sure the lessons drive real change in how we work to keep patients safe.

  • Performance: You set the KPIs and SLAs the operation runs on, and hold your leads to them. You objectively assess accurate data, and are responsible for the accuracy of that data.

  • Collaboration: You’re a senior voice in the leadership team. You bring clinical ops insight into company decisions and represent the service internally and externally.

 

Need to have

  • Experience: You have 3+ years leading teams in a high-growth, digital/telehealth organization.

  • CQC: You have experience as a CQC Registered Manager, and have taken a service through a CQC inspection and received rating Good or Outstanding.

  • Alignment: You have experience leading large clinical teams (>50), and you’ve likely led teams much larger than that (>100). You smoothly get large teams aligned so everyone’s adhering to protocols and SOPs.

  • Operator: You’re a killer operator, with a track record of running clinical operations based on metrics (SLAs, rotas, forecasting). You embrace accountability, and your reports do, too.

  • Metrics: You possess data fluency and understand the importance of accurate data when it comes to setting KPIs. You have owned critical KPIs in the past and don’t balk at the responsibility that comes with it.

  • Automation: You recognize that we’re in the midst of a technological revolution, and embrace AI and automation to kill off manual, clunky workflows. You ensure your team isn’t getting left behind.

  • Standards: You maintain exceptionally high standards, a bias to action and are happy to get stuck in. You detest pretentiousness.

Nice to have

  • Product & Engineering: You’ve worked with Product and Engineering to automate operational workflows in a start-up environment. You understand what they need and don’t make vague requests without clear justification. You validate what’s shipped yourself.

  • Scale: You’ve scaled a service through rapid growth and probably launched new clinical services or verticals along the way. You can “figure it out” as you go without needing your hand held.

  • Regulatory: You possess experience with regulators and standards beyond just the CQC, such as the GPhC, MHRA, ICO and/or DSPT

 

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

 

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About Frontier

Faculty Frontier™ is a decision operating system. It puts AI to work on the decisions that matter most to large organisations, such as where to invest, how to allocate resources, and when to act.

Every enterprise is investing heavily in AI, but few are confident it will improve performance. Too often it goes to what’s easy to automate, disconnected from the decisions that actually move the business.

Frontier works backwards from objectives like revenue, margin and risk to the decisions that drive them, then connects the data, models and agents those decisions need into a world model of the business. Teams simulate and optimise options with ADA, our AI decision agent, and every decision is tracked against its outcome so the system keeps learning. Our ambition is to make business decisions as easy to navigate as getting around a city.

We don’t believe in AI that thinks for people. We believe in AI that helps people think, with humans and agents working together inside a decision system.

Customers start with one high-value decision and prove value in weeks. Over months they connect it into a wider decision network, and over years they build an adaptive enterprise.

Frontier is built by Faculty, an AI company that has delivered more than 400 systems since 2014 and is now part of Accenture.

About Design at Frontier

We’re a small team, growing deliberately - we’d rather have five designers who trust each other than fifteen who don't.

We're tightly integrated with engineering. We prototype in code. We co-own the design system with developers. We're actively exploring what agentic-augmented design work looks like in practice, not in think pieces — and we're honest when we don't have the answer yet.

We’re active in shaping the product culture at Frontier; putting people first, raising the quality bar and ensuring a coherent experience. You’ll be part of shaping that culture.

About the role

You'll be one of the most senior designers on Frontier, shaping a product that's still early enough that the decisions you make will define how it works for years.

Day to day, you'll be designing the surfaces where people and agents collaborate on real clinical decisions — how evidence gets surfaced, how recommendations get explained, how humans push back, how teams learn. This is hard, unsolved design work. The existing patterns for AI interfaces mostly come from consumer chat products; they don't transfer cleanly to environments where the cost of a bad decision is measured in years of research or patient outcomes.

You'll be expected to work end-to-end: from framing the problem with product and engineering, through prototyping in code and design canvases, through shipping. You'll help set the craft bar for the team, mentor the designers around you, and push back when something isn't good enough yet.

What you'll work on

  • Designing the core interaction patterns for how humans and agents collaborate inside a decision loop.

  • Making dense, analytical information legible for expert users who need to trust it, challenge it, and act on it.

  • Shaping the shared design language and system that lets a small team move quickly without the product fragmenting.

  • Partnering with engineering from day one of any problem, not from handoff.

  • Raising the bar for craft — through your own work, through critique, and through the standards you hold the team to.

We think you'll do well here if

  • You've shipped complex software for expert users, in a domain where getting it wrong has real consequences.

  • You design end-to-end and care about the pixels as much as the strategy.

  • You've done serious work on AI or other non-deterministic systems and have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

  • You're comfortable prototyping in code, or motivated to get there.

  • You're direct, kind, and can hold a clear point of view without needing to be the loudest in the room.

  • You want the people who use your product to have better working lives because of it.

You might not enjoy this role if

  • You want to work on a mature product with established patterns. Frontier is early, and the ambiguity is real.

  • You prefer to work handoff-style, away from engineers.

  • You're looking for a role where design sets direction in isolation from product and engineering. We work as one team.

Interview process

  1. Intro call with our talent team (30 min)

  2. Conversation with Duncan, VP of Design (60 min)

  3. Portfolio and case study deep-dive (90 min)

  4. Final conversation with a cross-functional leader (60 min)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.

As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements.

This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.

Core Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and improve security controls across endpoints, servers, identity systems, cloud services, SaaS applications, networks, and data flows.
  • Drive security posture improvements through hardening standards, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, access controls, monitoring, and ongoing validation.
  • Assess security risks in new platforms, products, architectures, vendors, and services, and turn findings into practical recommendations and engineering work.
  • Build and maintain automation for security operations, including configuration validation, drift monitoring, patching, access reviews, policy enforcement, alert triage, and security hygiene.
  • Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and other Information Security teams to strengthen security architecture and address recurring risks.

title: Senior Demand & Merchandise Planner
description:
Make Your Mark as an Demand Planner at Storio group

About the role

Storio Group produces millions of personalised photo products every year across brands like Photobox, Hofmann, and Albelli. Our business is highly seasonal and promotional, and planning is how we stay ahead of it. Everything we sell is made to order. We turn sales data and commercial insight into forecasts of sales, volume and ASP that give the business sales and margin visibility and drive stock and production capacity decisions across Europe.

 

As Senior Demand & Merchandise Planner, you will be a core Subject Matter Expert in our rapidly developing S&OP function. Reporting to the Head of Demand Planning, you will bridge top-line commercial forecasts with item-level operational reality. You will validate B2C category sales, volume and ASP forecasts, own the sub-category and item mix beneath them, establish B2B forecasting, and improve forecast phasing across our peak cycles. This is a high-impact role where you will build quality into our planning process and support commercial and operational readiness.




How you embrace curiosity daily

Make your mark by taking on these core day-to-day responsibilities:

  • Validate and check Commercial & Marketing's monthly, weekly, and daily category top-line forecasts of sales, volume and ASP against run rates, promotional plans, and customer strategies

  • Challenge forecast assumptions constructively across key markets and products, including mix and ASP shifts, when inputs diverge from historical trends or operational reality

  • Own the detailed item planning process, splitting category forecasts into granular sub-category and item variant forecasts across sales, volume and ASP, providing item sales mix and margin visibility, and Operations with accurate production requirements

  • Decompose forecasts into their parts (baseline, commercial initiatives and new products), so each can be challenged and tracked

  • Drive continuous improvement in weekly and daily forecast phasing, reviewing and validating sales forecasts against promotional mechanics, seasonal uplift spikes, and Last Order Dates for key gifting events

  • Build pragmatic models and tools that help forecast owners submit higher-quality phasing inputs

  • Take end-to-end ownership of forecasting for B2B vendors, integrating these streams into the central S&OP process


    • How you make your mark

    In this role, you will deliver real impact across our commercial and supply chain objectives


  • Support robust commercial consensus by bringing planning expertise to cross-functional partners

  • Validate and check promotional phasing directly to Last Order Dates to improve peak season operational readiness

  • Provide sales, volume, ASP and margin visibility through accurate, granular item forecasts aligned to category forecasts from Commercial & Marketing

  • Close unforecasted blind spots by building baseline forecasts for B2B channels

  • Prepare variance analysis and scenario reporting packs for monthly demand review meetings

  • Partner with Supply Planning so item-level forecast changes translate smoothly into capacity planning

  • Identify opportunities to refine planning spreadsheets and models to remove manual friction and improve data integrity


    • What you bring to the team

  • Demand Planning, Merchandise Planning or Merchandising experience in a fast-paced environment like Retail, E-Commerce or FMCG

  • Experience forecasting sales value and ASP, not just volume, and using category and product mix to give margin visibility

  • Proven track record of managing item-level planning, category and product mix modelling, and promotional uplift analysis

  • Hands-on experience challenging commercial, trading or marketing teams on forecast assumptions using clear data

  • Advanced MS Excel or Google Sheets data modelling skills with complex multi-category and multi-country datasets

  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to manage defined processes independently

  • Practical problem-solving approach that favours workable tools over complex theoretical models


    • What sets you apart

  • Career experience with exposure to adjacent functions like Supply Planning, Trading, Marketing, or Finance

  • Background in seasonal, promotion-led, high-volume direct-to-consumer or multi-market businesses, along with experience using Demand or Merchandise Planning systems

  • Relevant formal education or degree in business, supply chain, or a related analytical field

You will have a clear scope, a supportive manager, and real opportunity to grow your expertise within a business that takes supply chain seriously.
